posts.name: HireKey
posts.tagline: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search
posts.description: HireKey is a recruiter-informed AI job-search co-pilot for tech job seekers who want to apply strategically & interview with confidence. It helps you assess your role fit, tailor resumes, communicate experience & track applications. Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

posts.name: kōdlo
posts.tagline: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context
posts.description: kōdlo finds prospects that fit your ICP and tells you how to warm each one up. Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

posts.name: Automations in Perplexity Computer
posts.tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
posts.description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

posts.name: Ghost Core
posts.tagline: A personal AI computer that runs entirely on-device
posts.description: Ghost Core is a personal AI computer that runs AI models on-device, connects to your apps, files, and devices, and builds continuous context to proactively help you.

posts.name: OpenScreen 2
posts.tagline: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits
posts.description: Record your screen and the demo looks great on the first take: zooms planned from your clicks, smooth cursor, 3D camera moves, cursor themes, backgrounds and webcam layouts. Then let your AI agent do the edit over MCP, or cut the video yourself by deleting words in the transcript. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, MIT, no account, no watermark.

posts.name: FocusWrite
posts.tagline: A local-first writing app with focus modes.
posts.description: A calm, local-first writing app with deep focus, ambient sounds, optional cloud sync, and PDF export.

posts.name: Foley
posts.tagline: A voice to-do list that files, plans and asks first
posts.description: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.

posts.name: MePersona
posts.tagline: Answer every fan comment in your voice
posts.description: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

posts.name: Gboard Kurukuru Version
posts.tagline: Your fingers stay put. The keys come around
posts.description: Gboard Kurukuru Version is a conveyor belt keyboard from Google Japan's Gboard team, its 15th. Four belts carry 29 keys each past your fingers, so one hand can reach every character. It isn't for sale, but STL files, firmware and a build guide are on GitHub.

posts.name: Edgee Mod for Claude Code
posts.tagline: Use any model inside Claude Code, keep your Claude plan
posts.description: A Claude Code mod that puts Edgee in your terminal. Keep your Claude plan, switch your session to any of 200+ models in one keystroke, and see live what compression and routing save you. Same conversation, same context. Two commands to install.

posts.name: Ayven
posts.tagline: Carries and drives your team's agenda
posts.description: Ayven drives your agenda. It means observing, cutting the work into pieces your team can take one at a time, putting an owner and a date on each, and filing them in Jira or YouTrack. Then it runs, tracks and talks about the work for weeks: asking whoever knows, waiting, chasing silence, moving work when someone is away. Your team answers in Slack and the board moves. Planning stops being the barrier and you ship your agenda like crazy.

posts.name: Agibot
posts.tagline: The always-on personal AI agent for your Mac. $0 forever
posts.description: Agibot is an always-on personal AI agent that runs on your Mac. It keeps working in the background, even after you close the window. It can send you a morning brief, keep an eye on things and tell you when something changes, and handle tasks on the web for you. Chat with it in the app, on Telegram or on Slack. It remembers what you tell it, learns from your corrections and asks before doing anything risky. Free forever with your own API key.

posts.name: SimpleSpread
posts.tagline: Native, open source Mac spreadsheet
posts.description: Ever double click a CSV or XLSX file on your mac and have to wait 30 seconds while Numbers loads? And when it loads it's filled with a ton of crap you don't need? Then I wrote this for you (well mostly me, but you might find it cool too). A small, fast spreadsheet for the Mac, written entirely in Swift. Free and MIT open source with XLSX as the native file format. 156 functions, incremental recalc, Excel-style keyboard editing.

posts.name: Tori
posts.tagline: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences
posts.description: One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.

posts.name: DevTerminal
posts.tagline: A macOS terminal with a Run button that knows your project
posts.description: DevTerminal is a normal macOS terminal (your shell, your config) where every tab knows what project it's in. ⌘R in an Android app installs it on your phone and streams logcat. In an iOS app it launches in the Simulator or on your iPhone. Spring Boot, Next.js, Flutter, React Native, Rust, Go, Django, Rails and more just work. Run output sits under your shell, so Claude Code keeps the tab. $39 once, no subscription.

posts.name: shippedit.me
posts.tagline: Launch Platform with SEO, AEO & Growth Insights
posts.description: Weekly launch battles + a permanent page that keeps working: dofollow backlink, AEO & CRO audits, competitor monitoring, real analytics, and AI fix cards.

posts.name: FloorGen
posts.tagline: Draw the house, or just ask. Free floor plans with AI
posts.description: Plan a remodel, an ADU or a whole house for free in your browser. Describe it and FloorGen AI builds it, every change an undo step. Then check it against the IRC, walk through it in 3D and print the plan set. Claude and ChatGPT can edit it too.

posts.name: Kooler
posts.tagline: Find cocktails you can make with what's in your bar
posts.description: Kooler is a free cocktail recipe app for people who like making drinks at home. - My Bar: add the bottles and ingredients you have and see every drink you can make right now - 100+ curated recipes: classics, modern cocktails and Brazilian drinks like Caipirinha, Rabo de Galo and Macunaíma - Clear measurements, step-by-step methods and consistent photos - Check-ins: rate a drink you had at a bar and share it No ads, no paywall. Web + iOS.

posts.name: Unboom
posts.tagline: Tames boomy room bass on your Mac without acoustic panels
posts.description: Unboom finds the bass note your untreated room exaggerates and gently turns just that down on your Mac. Scan with your mic or pick it by ear, choose Gentle, Medium, or Strong, and flip Correction on. Never boosts. No data collected. No subscription.

posts.name: NewMinecraftServers
posts.tagline: Minecraft server discovery, analytics, & spoof detection.
posts.description: NewMinecraftServers helps players find their next Minecraft community and gives server owners tools to grow theirs. Discover Java and Bedrock servers, explore player statistics, and follow activity trends before choosing where to play. Owners can claim and promote their server listing, showcase their community, and access detailed analytics on player counts, uptime, peak activity, and busiest hours -- making it easier to understand their audience and attract new players.

posts.name: Poke Finder
posts.tagline: Catch Pokémon while you browse and complete your Pokédex.
posts.description: Catch Pokémon while browsing. Discover Generations 1-9, Shiny Pokémon, Mega Evolution and companions with Poke Finder.

posts.name: Halo
posts.tagline: Notifications, dictation and AI agents in your Mac's notch
posts.description: Halo turns your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island: messages from any app, dictation that types anywhere when you hold Fn, a little face that follows your cursor and watches your AI agents, plus music, calls and monitor brightness. $9.99 once.

posts.name: EdgeVolume
posts.tagline: Control your Mac’s volume from your trackpad edge
posts.description: Slide one finger along your Mac’s trackpad edge to adjust the volume. Choose the left edge, right edge, or both, and tune the sensitivity to your preference. EdgeVolume is a free, open-source macOS utility that runs in your menu bar. Currently in early access.

posts.name: Farol
posts.tagline: The macOS terminal that shows which coding agent needs you
posts.description: Farol is a macOS terminal for running Claude Code and Codex in parallel. A sidebar shows which agent is working, which is waiting for you and which is done, and the menu bar shows it from any app. Each task gets its own git worktree, started from a prompt, a GitHub issue or a Jira ticket. Review the diff, commit, push and open the PR in the same window. Built on libghostty, so it reads your Ghostty config. Free and MIT licensed. No account, no telemetry.

posts.name: KarmaBoard
posts.tagline: A vintage split-flap message board for any TV
posts.description: A vintage split-flap message board for any TV. Display your own custom text, plus live feeds like weather, sports scores, stock prices and transit schedules... and watch every letter clack into place.

posts.name: Pickle Sensei
posts.tagline: AI pickleball coach for solo training, one swing at a time
posts.description: Pickle Sensei is an AI pickleball coach for solo training on iPhone. Step into the start zone alone, swing one stroke, and get an estimated player rating, a technique score, checkpoint scores, and the one thing to fix next. Covers serves, returns, drives, dinks, third-shot drops, volleys and overheads. Slow-motion form review with a skeleton overlay, 40+ drills, progress tracking and ranks. Video stays on your device. Free to try, one rating included, then Pro from $7.99 a month.

posts.name: NotchPit
posts.tagline: Your Mac's notch, rearranged into a control center
posts.description: NotchPit turns the space around your Mac's camera into a control center: music with synced lyrics, prayer times with adhan, your next meeting, and 64 extensions from uptime checks to revenue. Drag, resize and swipe them into your own layout. Try it free for 14 days, then buy once and keep it for life.

posts.name: SwarmPane
posts.tagline: One desktop workspace for all your AI coding agents
posts.description: SwarmPane is a desktop workspace for the coding agents you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok, Cursor and more, each in a real terminal, up to 16 side by side. See which one needs you, race two on the same task and let your tests pick the winner, undo any agent step, and keep going when a usage limit hits. Use several Claude Code or Codex accounts, chain agents into workflows, and talk to them with Voice on Mac. For Mac, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: Find Right Plugin
posts.tagline: Find Right WordPress Plugin in 60 Seconds
posts.description: Free WordPress plugin recommender. Answer 3 questions and get a personalized shortlist matched to your problem and your role. No sign-up is required to use either quiz. Recommendations are based on a weighted rubric (ratings, active installs, update recency, WP version compatibility, support, and more) rather than which vendor pays the highest commission — free tools are recommended over paid ones wherever they're honestly the better fit, and this is stated plainly on results pages.

posts.name: Squidbrake
posts.tagline: Change control for AI agents: sign-off, undo and a record
posts.description: Every action your AI agents take (commands, refunds, emails, database changes) goes on a tamper-evident record. Routine ones run; risky ones wait for a second person, who sees what led to it, with an undo. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, MCP. Free, open source.

posts.name: Lichy for iOS
posts.tagline: Type what you spent. Lichy does the rest.
posts.description: Lichy is an iOS expense tracker where you just write what you spent, like "coffee 80" or "lunch 450", and it's logged. Scan receipts, capture Apple Pay automatically, track multiple currencies and subscriptions. Simple by design.

posts.name: Scaloom DFY
posts.tagline: Get customers from Reddit - without doing Reddit yourself
posts.description: Scaloom is your done-for-you Reddit growth team. We research the conversations your customers are already having, create useful posts and comments, and publish through managed high-karma accounts. You get 2 strategic posts per week, 50+ human-reviewed comments per month, GEO/SEO opportunity targeting, and AI visibility tracking, helping your brand get discovered across Reddit, Google, and AI search.

posts.name: SLOP WITH FRENS
posts.tagline: Build weird things together
posts.description: Build games, apps, and weird internet things with your friends and AI. Start an idea, invite your frens, suggest changes, and vote on what gets built next. Watch it come together in a shared live preview, play with what you made, then keep changing it. See how long a simple racing game stays a simple racing game.

posts.name: Pushie
posts.tagline: Get notified when something happens
posts.description: Pushie lets you send notifications to yourself or your friends from anywhere. Create an account, claim a username, and start pushing to every device you are signed in on with a single HTTP request. This is ideal for automated alerts. Use it as a webhook receiver for your CI/CD pipeline, AI agents, cron jobs, background workers, or any process that needs to tell you when something happens. No app or SDK to install. No complex authentication. Just a simple HTTP POST request with your message.

posts.name: Scribbble
posts.tagline: Draw over anything on your Mac screen with one hotkey
posts.description: Scribbble lets you draw on top of any app on your Mac. Press a hotkey, sketch, press it again to clear. No windows, no setup, no subscription. Pen, arrows, rectangles, highlighter, spotlight, magnifier, measure, text, whiteboard and auto-fading strokes, each one keystroke away. Works across multiple monitors. Built for live demos, teaching, streaming and screen recordings. Free to try, one-time $12 license with lifetime updates.

posts.name: Wraps
posts.tagline: Amazon SES, set up and run for you in your own AWS
posts.description: One command deploys Amazon SES into your own AWS account: DKIM, SPF, DMARC, event tracking and suppression. Then Wraps runs it, checking bounce and complaint rates hourly against the lines where AWS pauses accounts. React Email templates, TypeScript workflows, broadcasts, segments, unlimited contacts. Agent sends pass a kill switch, allowlist and caps in your account. Free plan, and AWS bills sending at about $10 per 100k. Open source under AGPL-3.0. You need an AWS account.

posts.name: Liniqo
posts.tagline: Hairline isometric illustrations as SVG, PNG and animated
posts.description: Liniqo: hairline isometric illustrations as SVG, PNG and animated files. 300 free pieces to download.

posts.name: Chesspy
posts.tagline: Daily logic puzzle: place chess pieces to hit every number
posts.description: Chesspy is a daily logic puzzle with one rule: each number shows how many chess pieces attack that square. Place rooks, bishops and knights so every number is hit exactly and every 0 stays untouched. One piece can satisfy two numbers and break a third. A solver checks that every board can be solved by pure logic, no guessing. 20 boards a day, the same for everyone, then your Top %. Free, no ads, no account, on iPhone and the web.

posts.name: Puckit
posts.tagline: AI photobombs your images with a deadpan green creature
posts.description: Give Puck a photo, screenshot, or meme. He studies the scene, picks a context-aware visual joke, and edits himself into it. Choose Sneaky, Normal, or Unhinged, then compare, download, or share the result. No prompts or signup. Free, with daily limits. Any image. Pucked.

posts.name: KiwiDesk v2.2.0
posts.tagline: Peak speed meets beautiful UI.
posts.description: KiwiDesk is a tiling window manager for macOS that works right out of the box. No complex config files required. Key Features: • No-Code Settings + optional Lua Scripting • No disabling SIP • fully customizable • native desktop support • build in focus borders as well as app indication bars (of course also optional) 100% free & source is available on GitHub.

posts.name: KiwiDesk v2.2.0
posts.tagline: Peak speed meets beautiful UI.
posts.description: KiwiDesk is a tiling window manager for macOS that works right out of the box. No complex config files required. Key Features: • No-Code Settings + optional Lua Scripting • No disabling SIP • fully customizable • native desktop support • build in focus borders as well as app indication bars (of course also optional) 100% free & source is available on GitHub.

posts.name: Blackbird Finance
posts.tagline: Automated financial OS for domestic & cross-border trade
posts.description: Blackbird Finance is a unified back-office stack built to automate domestic e-invoicing, GST compliance, cross-border remittance tracking, and crypto settlement workflows. We eliminate broken trade portal steps, SWIFT e-FIRC chasing, and manual tax reserve calculations into a single pane of glass. Processing $1.3M+ in annualized volume across 41 paying teams with 94.5% retention, Blackbird helps modern businesses manage global cash flow without compliance headaches.

posts.name: DoneCut
posts.tagline: Upload raw footage. Get a finished YouTube edit from $49
posts.description: DoneCut edits your YouTube videos and Shorts. Upload raw footage and see the exact price before you pay: $49 for up to 10 minutes of footage, Shorts from $29. Pay half, and an AI editor cuts it and adds captions, motion graphics and music. Watch a watermarked preview, get two rounds of changes, then pay the rest. Most edits are ready in under 90 minutes. The first 10 edits are free while we launch.

posts.name: Pixxta
posts.tagline: Your guests snap away. The whole party sees it live.
posts.description: Guests scan a QR code and post photos from their own phones, no app download. Everyone follows a live feed on their phone; the projector wall is optional and animates each new photo onto the big screen as it arrives. Afterwards, the gallery sorts photos into moments and shows who else shot the same moment.

posts.name: Kitfox
posts.tagline: Find the right leads. Reach them the right way.
posts.description: Kitfox’s AI finds the right companies on Google and Maps, skips marketplaces and directories, and scores each one A, B or C against what you sell, with reasons. Already have a list? Drop in a CSV or Excel file and Kitfox researches each lead and plans who your team contacts today, with a draft ready. It never sends for you. You send from your own email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn or phone, then log the result. Free in beta, no card, no API keys.

posts.name: fancanon
posts.tagline: The Modern Fanfiction Platform
posts.description: Fanfiction community has spent nearly 2 decades dealing with dated layouts, overwhelming UI/UX and crippling restrictions. Fancanon rebuilds the fanfiction experience from the ground up as a fast, clean, reader & writer focused web app. What makes it different you ask? Modern UI/UX, Music Pairing, Audio Narration, Community and Reader-centric features, as well as a modern writing experience.

posts.name: OpenAPIPricing
posts.tagline: Transparent Pricing for APIs
posts.description: OpenAPIPricing is an open research project on API pricing. We read the public pricing pages of 150 APIs across 19 categories, record the plans, free tiers and billing models, and publish every figure with its source link and the date we verified it. We also email providers to get the latest pricing. Each API gets a pricing guide, and the biggest names get side-by-side comparisons. The goal is simple: pricing anyone can check without a sales call.

posts.name: Event Schedule
posts.tagline: Open source event calendar, ticketing and bookings
posts.description: One page for everything you have on. Event Schedule gives venues, performers and communities a public calendar, free registration, bookable appointments and ticketing with QR check-in at the door. It takes no cut of ticket sales, so the money goes straight to your own Stripe or PayPal account. It's open source: self-host it with every feature unlocked, or use the hosted version, where the calendar and free registration cost nothing and paid ticketing is $5 a month.

posts.name: ASCII Studio
posts.tagline: Your photos as ASCII art - private, instant, in-browser
posts.description: ASCII Studio turns any image into ASCII art, entirely in your browser. Drop a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, tune the character ramp, color and dithering with a live preview, then export as TXT, PNG, SVG, HTML or an embed snippet. Nothing is uploaded - your image never leaves your device. Free, no signup.

posts.name: ShapingQR
posts.tagline: Free Dynamic QR code generator
posts.description: Beautiful, reliable, and easy to change later. Free, with live preview and PNG, SVG and PDF downloads.

posts.name: Memory Classic
posts.tagline: The classic pairs game, with five ways to play
posts.description: Memory Classic brings matching pairs to iPhone and iPad with five ways to play: solo, Time Attack, local two-player, online Game Center matches and educational activities. Explore up to 10 card packs, each with 25 levels, four complete themes and customizable card backs. Pair pictures with words, lowercase with uppercase letters, or words in different languages, with spoken cards and custom pairs. Independent since 2012. Available in 24 languages. Free to download with optional card packs.

posts.name: My Handler
posts.tagline: Screen capture. Dictation. Files. Meetings. Phone it. Local.
posts.description: MyHandler is a local-first AI assistant that knows your entire digital life and even let's you phone and text it for assistance! It's for people who don't want their email, meetings, files and calls stored on someone else's server. All your data stays on your machine, and uses a locally hosted model. Cloud AI is opt-in. Meeting transcripts run via local Whisper.

posts.name: flick
posts.tagline: Pick the browser, app or email for every link you click.
posts.description: flick is a browser picker for mac. click any link and it opens in the right browser or app, by a rule you set once or a picker at your cursor. email links too. strips tracking junk, unwraps safe links, private, on device, free to start

posts.name: ElevenAgents Architect
posts.tagline: AI expert that builds and improves voice agents
posts.description: ElevenAgents Architect is an AI expert built into ElevenLabs that builds and improves your voice agents. Describe an agent in plain language, or point it at a failing test, escalation spike, or transcripts from thousands of calls. It drafts the fix, explains it, and writes simulations. Every change is a versioned draft you review, approve, or revert before it goes live. Alpha. Also reachable from Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor.

posts.name: Tansei
posts.tagline: A simple shelf for Mac and Windows
posts.description: Tansei sits at the edge of your screen and keeps everything you copy: text, links, images, files, colors & screenshots. When you need something, drag it straight back into any app. No more digging through folders or losing the thread between apps. Built for people who switch between apps all day. Pin what you use most, search everything, and keep your place. One purchase, no subscription, no account. Everything stays on your device.

posts.name: Ainux Domain Intelligence
posts.tagline: Privacy-first domain research, powered by WebAssembly
posts.description: A browser-native domain intelligence tool built to make domain research more private and practical. Its core engine runs locally using WebAssembly and Web Workers, enabling large-scale bulk scanning without routing domain scans through an Ainux backend. Tested with 2,500 domains completed in 37.7 seconds.

posts.name: Melodic Master
posts.tagline: Master your mix with profiles and reference-guided tools
posts.description: Help a rough mix feel more finished without losing control of the sound. Upload a song, audition mastering profiles, and refine EQ, dynamics, saturation and stereo image. Use a reference track for guided adjustments and loudness targets, compare the result, then export WAV or MP3 from the browser. Melodic Master is built for independent artists, producers and demo polishing. Start free, with optional paid upgrades for more tools and access. Also available on Android.

posts.name: Agents of Chaos by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Play the first AI PM at a chaotic startup, in your browser
posts.description: A free browser game where you are the first AI product manager at a seed-stage startup. Sit in meetings, ask a few sharp questions, make the call, and watch trust, revenue and morale react. Situations come from real AI product incidents and real AI PM job posts. No login to start.

posts.name: Americanoo
posts.tagline: One padel game. Any phone, browser, watch or AI agent
posts.description: Padel night, minus the whiteboard; plus Agents. 🎾 Start an Americano in 30 seconds, flash a QR code, and the whole group is in: iPhone, Android, web, even your watch or Agent. 👯 Everyone can edit: whoever finishes first enters the score ⌚ Apple Watch & Wear OS: spin the crown, tap Save 🤖 Tell your AI agent "set up an Americano for these 8" and it's done (MCP) 📶 Club Wi-Fi died? Scores wait and sync ⚖️ 8 formats, fair rotations Free. No ads. No sign-up.

posts.name: Ringtone Cropper
posts.tagline: Free ringtone maker for Android & iPhone, in your browser
posts.description: Turn audio files or permitted YouTube links into Android and iPhone ringtones. Trim the waveform, add fades, and export MP3, M4A, M4R or WAV. Free and open source, with no account needed. Local files and editing stay in your browser.

Use a reference track for guided adjustments and loudness targets, compare the result, then export WAV or MP3 from the browser. Melodic Master is built for independent artists, producers and demo polishing. Start free, with optional paid upgrades for more tools and access. Also available on Android.

posts.name: AI Reel Generator
posts.tagline: AI Reel Generator: Create Reels from Text & Photos
posts.description: Free AI reel generator: turn text or photos into videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Start creating with no editing skills or experience.

posts.name: ApriDoc.com
posts.tagline: Apri file P7M e lavora sui PDF, online
posts.description: Apri filep7m online, unisci, dividi, ruota e converti PDF direttamente nel browser. Gratis, senza registrazione e senza caricare i tuoi documenti su nessun server.

posts.name: Savedly
posts.tagline: Save anything. Find it instantly.
posts.description: Savedly is an open-source self-hostable asecond brain for everything you want to save online. Save links, articles, videos, and notes in one place, then find them later using what you remember instead of searching through endless bookmarks or remembering exact titles. Built for people who are tired of losing useful things across browser bookmarks, social media, and chat apps. Save now. Find it when you need it.

posts.name: Chatmetric, WhatsApp Chat Analyzer
posts.tagline: See who texts more, reply times, activity and top emojis.
posts.description: WhatsApp and Instagram chat analyzer: see who texts more, reply times, activity and top emojis in any chat or group. Your first analysis is free.

posts.name: Send A Vent
posts.tagline: Resolve disputes, reach agreements & engage civic leaders
posts.description: The internet is full of noise. We get it done. • AI Mediation & Dashboard: Find common ground and track disputes to resolution. • CURE: Snap a photo or upload any letter to auto-draft and send a response. • Agreements & FairPath Resolution: Escalate stubborn issues and execute binding accords. • Business Complaints & Town Hall: Resolve consumer disputes and question representatives. • Tracked postal and digital delivery, backed by a community forum.

posts.name: HourOps
posts.tagline: Manage Projects, tasks, timesheets, leaves and invoices
posts.description: HourOps brings projects, tasks, timesheets, leave, invoices, vendor accounts and team administration into one secure workspace. Build custom workflows, assign work, track hours, manage time off and move completed work to invoicing without stitching together separate tools. Fine-grained roles keep every team member focused on what they can access, while the AI assistant helps with everyday operations.

posts.name: Salah Live – Find Masjids & Jamaat Times
posts.tagline: Find Your Nearest Masjid, Never Miss Salah and Jamaat.
posts.description: Meet Salah Live 🕌 — find nearby Masjids and their actual Jamaat timings, updated by local admins. "Our Prophet (ﷺ) says that prayer in congregation is 27 times more rewarding than praying alone." Salah Live is our humble effort to help you attain this beautiful reward. Our humble niyat is simple: help even one person find their nearest Masjid and make it to Salah and Jamaat they might otherwise miss. If we achieve that, "It would be beneficial in this world along with the Hereafter", InshaAllah.

posts.name: MyTwinVoice
posts.tagline: Your voice. Your knowledge. Always available.
posts.description: Upload your voice, photos, documents and videos, and MyTwinVoice builds an AI twin that talks like you — in your own cloned voice. Share one link and anyone can ask it questions, by text or by voice. Free forever to start: 1 twin, 100 messages a day, 50 uploads. Upgrade for more twins, unlimited messages and unlimited professional voice. EU-hosted, GDPR-compliant, and you can delete your twin at any time.

posts.name: SeoGeoAeo AI
posts.tagline: Make your website SEO, AEO & GEO ready in one click
posts.description: Search engines, answer engines and AI search. Make your website SEO, AEO & GEO ready. Enter your URL to see where your site stands today and get prioritized tips to improve it. Fine-tune it yourself, or give the checks to your AI agent.

posts.name: Callback
posts.tagline: Create resumes, interviews, and land your next opportunity
posts.description: Callback tailors your resume to every job with two AI models that check each other's work — ATS-safe templates, keyword matching, cover letters and interview practice.

posts.name: Nox Hall
posts.tagline: Your browser game hall. Poker now, more games to come.
posts.description: Nox Hall is a free browser game platform, starting with No-Limit Texas Hold’em. Play against labelled bots, join Quick Play, or invite friends to a private room. Start as a guest, learn the rules in the lobby, and keep your progress when you register. Chips are virtual and can’t be bought or cashed out. More games, including chip-free play, are in development and under wraps.

posts.name: CorvaneOS
posts.tagline: The AI Operating System for Startup Teams, and Investors
posts.description: Startups juggle a docs tool, a chat app, a CRM, an ATS and spreadsheets. CorvaneOS replaces them with one workspace: projects, tasks, docs, team chat, sales, customer feedback and hiring, all on shared data. What's different: • HEYAI, a built-in agent that knows your company and flags what's slipping • Investor workspaces for angels, syndicates and VCs to follow portfolio progress, so founders skip the PDF update Every plan includes every module.

posts.name: Emetli
posts.tagline: Learn first, play after
posts.description: Stop fighting over screen time. Emetli keeps the apps you pick locked with Apple's Screen Time until your child learns: one minute of learning, one minute of play. Kids read illustrated books, play fifteen math games, explore short STEM articles and pick up Spanish or English with swipe-up videos, all matched to their age. You set the daily minimum behind a PIN. No ads, no kids' accounts, nothing to buy, and the list of locked apps never leaves the device. Free for iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: AssessrLog
posts.tagline: Run Every Federal Assessment in One Place.
posts.description: AssessrLog is an assessment platform that runs a regulated assessment end to end and produces a defensible, cryptographically sealed record, where other tools are general-purpose GRC suites built to track controls for a security team. It launches with CMMC Level 1 for the U.S. Defense Industrial base and is built for the assessments that follow. Users can work every objective, attach the evidence, and seal each determination in a hash-chained ledger.

posts.name: World Stock Market Clock
posts.tagline: Never miss a market open or close again
posts.description: World Stock Market Clock shows real-time open/closed status, countdowns, and customizable alerts for 60+ global stock exchanges. Home Screen widgets, Live Activities, and a Time Machine. Offline-first, no account required.

posts.name: Mockship
posts.tagline: Turn plain screenshots into polished mockups in minutes
posts.description: Drop in a screenshot, get a matching background, add a browser or phone frame, and export up to 6K. Includes full-page screenshots, progressive blur, templates, and Slides for seamless X carousels. No Figma templates, no Photoshop. Built solo.

posts.name: aiToggler
posts.tagline: AI chat, image, video, audio & 3D creation in one workspace
posts.description: Stop switching platforms to use different AI models. aiToggler brings AI chat, image, video, audio, and 3D creation into one workspace. aiToggler is meant to remove multiple subscriptions (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.) and keep all AI providers under one roof for easy access. Choose models with live rankings and speed and pricing comparisons, run up to four chats side by side, and track generation costs as you go.

posts.name: allclip
posts.tagline: Turn one action camera into an AI sports cameraman
posts.description: allclip turns a single 360° action camera into an AI sports cameraman. Set it on a tall tripod, record the match, and upload. Our computer vision follows the play and every player, then delivers a broadcast-style full-match video plus a highlight reel for each player, ready to share with the team. No camera operator, no expensive proprietary hardware. Used by ~50 clubs in Japan, including J.League academies. Built by sports computer vision researchers.

posts.name: Quechains
posts.tagline: Real-time global supply chain visibility & control
posts.description: QueChains is a supply chain platform for freight forwarders, 3PLs, manufacturers, and procurement teams in fast-growing markets. Get real-time multi-modal shipment tracking (ocean, air, road), AI-powered disruption alerts, automated customs documentation, and warehouse/inventory management in one dashboard. Unlike legacy tools like SAP TM or Oracle TMS, QueChains is built and priced for growth-market logistics teams: enterprise-grade visibility, without the enterprise price tag.

posts.name: react-native-phone-number-hint
posts.tagline: Permission-free phone number hint for React Native
posts.description: A permission-free React Native TurboModule for Android’s current Phone Number Hint API, with iOS autofill props. No contacts, phone, or SMS permissions. Cancellation and unavailable Play Services are handled safely.

posts.name: allclip
posts.tagline: Turn one action camera into an AI sports cameraman
posts.description: allclip turns a single 360° action camera into an AI sports cameraman. Set it on a tall tripod, record the match, and upload. Our computer vision follows the play and every player, then delivers a broadcast-style full-match video plus a highlight reel for each player, ready to share with the team. No camera operator, no expensive proprietary hardware. Used by ~50 clubs in Japan, including J.League academies. Built by sports computer vision researchers.

posts.name: DocuCognito
posts.tagline: AI Forms, Dynamic Word Templates & Certified E-Signatures
posts.description: DocuCognito is an all-in-one platform that turns simple text prompts into smart intake forms, dynamic Word (.docx) templates, and real-time dashboards. Eliminate repetitive document drafting and third-party tools by automatically populating agreements, executing legally binding e-signatures with cryptographic audit seals, and tracking conversion metrics in seconds. Built for solo founders, agencies, and teams who want to automate document workflows without writing code.

posts.name: TankhaPay
posts.tagline: Hire, pay and manage every workforce on one HRMS
posts.description: A global HRMS with AI recruitment built in. AI screens and ranks candidates, then hires flow straight into onboarding, attendance and payroll, no re-entry. Built for corporate, on-roll, contract and gig teams across entities, states and countries.

posts.name: Brod
posts.tagline: Put the apps your AI agent builds online for your team
posts.description: Brod is a cloud for the small software your team builds with AI. Add one MCP server to your agent, say "put this online for the team", and get a private HTTPS address with sign-in, roles, a database and rollback already there. Free for 3 apps and 3 people.

posts.name: TripleCheck
posts.tagline: Email, phone & IP validation in one single API
posts.description: TripleCheck is a 3-in-1 validation API for developers. Validate email addresses, phone numbers, and IP addresses through one simple API. Credits that never expire.

posts.name: WiPals
posts.tagline: Your closest friends' status, right on your Lock Screen
posts.description: Built by a solo developer. WiPals is a private circle for you and your 7 closest friends. From what your phone already knows (battery, motion, home/work/out, weather, the song playing) it writes one short, funny line and puts it on your friends' Lock Screens. You do nothing: no posting, no texting. 1,900+ hand-written lines in 7 languages. Privacy is the point: coordinates never leave the phone, no ads, no trackers, and every status disappears after 24 hours.

posts.name: Wingral
posts.tagline: Compare ideas, designs, and messaging with real feedback
posts.description: Share a simple test with your audience, collect their preferences and reasons, and turn the responses into a clear report.

posts.name: Kubflow AI
posts.tagline: Every AI image, video & ad model on one canvas
posts.description: Create AI images, videos and ads with Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more at the providers' own prices, no markup. Paste your website for a finished video ad, cast UGC avatars, remake viral trends, or let the AI Agent build it for you.

posts.name: Cangzhang Check
posts.tagline: Trace fixed 3PL fee differences to source rows
posts.description: A browser-local checker for fixed 3PL picking, extra-item and packaging fees. Compare standardized rate, activity and invoice tables; review source-linked differences and unresolved rows. Free synthetic demo; proposed US$99 pilot after a fit check.

posts.name: TickOS
posts.tagline: Email, forms, help center & API in one calm support inbox
posts.description: TickOS turns every message into a ticket. Email on your own domain, web forms, your help center & community, booking pages and a REST API all flow into one calm inbox. Add a knowledge base, changelog, broadcasts, scheduling and automations with an AI agent — in one workspace. Unlimited tickets and teammates on every plan, including Free. Pay for email volume, never per seat.

posts.name: Unvail
posts.tagline: Check images, video, music and text for signs of AI
posts.description: Unvail (pronounced like "Unveil") is a web app and extension that shows how likely an image, video, audio or text is generated with AI, and checks the claims in articles against public sources. Works on all sites you browse. Currently only available in the US.

posts.name: Free PDF Tools
posts.tagline: Free PDF Website which processes and stores data in browser.
posts.description: Convert files to PDF or PDF to Word, merge, split, rotate, delete, edit, protect, unlock and watermark PDFs in your browser. Files stay on your device.

posts.name: Ares: Fitness Tracking
posts.tagline: Track every step, fuel your goals, and train smarter.
posts.description: Ares goes beyond workout tracking. Track walks, runs, cycling, and hikes with GPS, monitor whole-day steps and NEAT, and get personalized Body Activation insights, eating targets, body goals, and suggested sessions. Review progress, share achievements, and compete with friends. Track activities offline with local storage, and optionally sync your data through Google sign-in. Make every step count.

posts.name: Bippa
posts.tagline: Self-checkout for the clubhouse fridge, paid with MobilePay
posts.description: Bippa turns any fridge into a self-checkout. Buyers scan the QR code, scan what they take and pay with MobilePay. No app, no till, no cash tin. The club sees what sold, what's running low and where every krone went.

posts.name: Noted
posts.tagline: Public thank-yous for your Slack team, with /merci
posts.description: Noted lets teammates thank each other in Slack with /merci @person message. The thank-you is posted in the channel, points are tracked per workspace, and weekly recaps can be posted. Free during early access.

posts.name: dailypedia
posts.tagline: Personalized daily Wikipedia reads, tuned to your curiosity
posts.description: Six million Wikipedia articles. One, chosen for you each day. Pick from 18 worlds and 64 topics; in under a minute they become a map of your curiosity. Like or skip, and tomorrow's pick gets more personal. No feed, no trending list, no pressure to keep scrolling: read it, and you're done. Your taste profile is drawn from the same picks and reactions that choose your reads, so you watch your curiosity take shape. iOS readers can translate articles on-device. Free, no ads.

posts.name: Driftlog
posts.tagline: A travel map that fills itself in while the app is closed
posts.description: Grant location once and leave Driftlog closed: it records the countries, regions and cities you pass through, with dates, and rebuilds trips from before you installed it using the GPS in your photo library. No account, no server, no subscription.

posts.name: Amendro
posts.tagline: Price extra work before your crew starts
posts.description: Price a construction change, show its schedule impact and print a clear document free, without an account. Save changes, attachments and versioned client review links for $39/month USD after a 14-day trial. No card required.
